title: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Paradigm
subtopics: decentralized structured P2P (DHT, Chord, Pastry, Kademlia)
P2P applications: file sharing, VoIP (Skype), video streaming

definitions.definition: Peer-to-Peer – distributed architecture where participants share resources directly
Distributed Hash Table – decentralized lookup service for P2P networks
Virtual network built on top of a physical network
P2P file sharing protocol using swarms and trackers
Structured P2P protocol using consistent hashing for node lookup
First widely used centralized P2P file-sharing system

learning_objectives: Classify P2P systems: centralized, decentralized structured, decentralized unstructured, hybrid
